title: Share a route prefix
summary: Gin: Share a route prefix. Add another route inside api.
introduction: A group gives related handlers a common path prefix. Open GET /api/books.
learningObjectives: Share a route prefix with Gin

blocks.text: Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Share a route prefix

blocks.text: The api group adds /api to /books before matching the route.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The group prefix belongs in the requested URL.
